chunks: He created the skies without a support, as you can see, and placed stabilisers in the earth that you may dwell at ease as it revolves; and dispersed on it all varieties of creatures, and He sent down water from the skies and grew all kinds of splendid things upon it.
ai.seo_question: How did Allah create the heavens and stabilize the earth according to this verse?
ai.summary: In the context of Luqman’s wisdom, this verse highlights Allah’s omnipotence in creating the heavens without visible pillars and stabilizing the earth with mountains to prevent it from shaking with its inhabitants. It further mentions the dispersal of all living creatures on earth and the sending down of rain from the sky to cause diverse, noble plants to grow, serving as a sign for those who reflect.
